# BB00595 {.unnumbered}

Say: O God! Thou art the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Thou givest innate nature unto whomsoever Thou willest and takest it away from whomsoever Thou willest. Thou exaltest whomsoever Thou willest and abasest whomsoever Thou willest. Thou raisest up whomsoever Thou willest and bringest low whomsoever Thou willest. Thou grantest victory unto whomsoever Thou willest and causest to fail whomsoever Thou willest. Thou enrichest whomsoever Thou willest and makest poor whomsoever Thou willest. Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of all things. Thou createst whatsoever Thou willest, how Thou willest, by what means Thou willest, and for what purpose Thou willest. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest, O Best of Protectors. In our own house, the sister of Aqa Mir-Siyyid.
